errors.text_span: This pie chart presents the distribution of clustering results for the FineWeb-Edu Classifier
errors.evidence: The figure contains TWO pie charts - one for AttentionInfluence and one for FineWeb-Edu Classifier. The description only mentions the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, missing the AttentionInfluence chart entirely.
The description completely omits the AttentionInfluence pie chart, which is the left chart and equally important to the figure's purpose of comparing the two clustering results.

errors.text_span: the largest slice being "Science & technology education" at approximately 19%, followed by "Education" at 17%, and "Healthy education" at 15%
errors.evidence: According to the reference, in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, 'Education' is the overall largest category (38%), 'Science & technology education' is 19% and 'Teaching & resources' is 17%, not 'Education' at 17%. 'Healthy education' is 2%, not 15%.
According to the reference, each pie chart contains 6 inner slices and 15 outer slices (21 total per chart). Twenty-eight slices does not match.

errors.text_span: "Historical review" is represented by a prominent, exploded slice, colored in orange, and "Events & people" is visually emphasized, appearing offset from the other slices
errors.evidence: The reference states 'there is no visual emphasis on any slice except for proportional representation.' Neither 'Historical review' nor 'Events & people' are described as exploded or offset.
The description does not mention that the charts have both inner and outer slices (double-ring/donut structure with main categories in the inner ring and sub-categories in the outer ring).

errors.text_span: The slices are colored in shades of blue, orange, and green
errors.evidence: The reference describes the charts as using multiple colors including blue, brown, orange, red, pink, light blue, and green. The description omits brown, red, and pink colors.
The description does not mention that 'Fin & Law' is one of the main categories in the AttentionInfluence chart, nor that the FineWeb-Edu Classifier appears to be missing this category.

errors.text_span: several other slices appearing to be roughly between 10% and 12%
errors.evidence: The reference shows the largest category in FineWeb-Edu Classifier is 'Education' at 38%, which is far larger than 10-12%. The description's characterization of proportions is misleading.
